title: ""

---

## The problem

What are you trying to do that you can't do today, or find clunky? Describe the problem, not just the feature — it's easier to evaluate a solution once the actual need is clear.

## What you'd like to happen

A clear description of the feature or change you're proposing.

## Alternatives considered

Any other ways you've thought about solving this, and why they don't fit as well.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, examples from other tools, related issues.
